summary: WebCodecs/ImageDecoder received several safety and correctness fixes: initialization was hardened against reentrant calls, cropping now only swizzles (reorders color bytes) for the visible rect on RGBA-backed VideoFrames, and ArrayBuffer transfer failures in ImageDecoder now propagate exceptions instead of leaving bogus pointers. These changes reduce crashes and data-corruption risks when using WebCodecs, VideoFrame, and ImageDecoder APIs.
